newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Three Colombian rebels die in weekend clash.
newsitem.headline: Three Colombian rebels die in weekend clash.

text.p: Three leftist rebels were killed in a clash with counterinsurgency troops in southwest Colombia early on Sunday, military sources said.

All were members of the National Liberation Army (ELN), Colombia's second largest guerrilla army. One of the trio, identified only by his nom-de-guerre Manuel, was thought to be a leading ELN ideologue, according to Col. Jose Castelblanco, who headed the operation in Cauca province.

In a separate operation on Saturday in eastern Boyaca province, police arrested a woman and seized 100 ELN uniforms. Police chief Col. Roberto Pizarro said the woman, Eva Maria Castro, was the treasurer and secretary of a youth group for miners' children and apparently doubled as a local treasurer for the rebel army.
